LightningComponentBundle.description: Three-step kiosk: scan Pag-IBIG card, capture details, issue and print a one-day pass.

property.name: autoResetSeconds
property.label: Auto-reset after (seconds)
property.description: Seconds on the pass screen before the kiosk returns to the scan step. Set 0 to disable.

property.name: membershipId
property.label: Day pass membership ID
property.description: The shared Landers membership number encoded in the printed barcode.

property.name: membershipName
property.label: Day pass membership name
property.default: PAG IBIG LANDERS ALL STORE DAYPASS
